svg.title: OutputCommitCoordinator — Speculative Attempt Race
svg.desc: First-eligible-asker permission gate for (stage=17, partition=7), TaskCommitDenied, and owner slot clearing. 1. DAGScheduler to OutputCommitCoord: stageStart(s17, maxP) (in-JVM); 2. FileCommitProtocol to OutputCommitCoord: canCommit(17,0,p7,A1) (:41000); 3. OutputCommitCoord to FileCommitProtocol: Grant: true (owner=A1) (:41000); 4. Task Attempt to OutputCommitCoord: canCommit(p7,A0) -> false (:41000); 5. Executor to DAGScheduler: KILLED: TaskCommitDenied (:41000); 6. FileCommitProtocol to HDFS NameNode: A1 commitTask -> rename (:8020)
